units.en: The officials who had been deceived and misled by Jie and his confederates, and whose involvement had not yet been discovered while they remained in office, were pardoned of their crimes."
units.literal: Their officials who were deceived and misled by Jie and others, not yet discovered while in office, remove their crimes."

units.zh: 詔曰：「朕閔百姓未贍，前年減漕三百萬石。
units.en: An edict stated: 'I pity the common people who are not yet satisfied. Last year we reduced the tribute by three million shi.
units.literal: Edict said: I pity common people not satisfied, previous year reduced tribute three million shi.

units.zh: 頗省乘輿馬及菀馬，以補邊郡三輔傳馬。
units.en: We somewhat economized on the imperial carriage horses and park horses in order to supplement the relay horses of the border commanderies and the Three Adjuncts.
units.literal: Somewhat economized imperial carriage horses and park horses, to supplement border commanderies three adjutants relay horses.

units.zh: 其令郡國毋斂今年馬口錢，三輔、太常郡得以叔粟當賦。」
units.en: Moreover, command the commanderies and kingdoms not to collect this year's horse tax. The Three Adjuncts and the Grand Minister of Ceremonies' commandery may use coarse grain to substitute for taxes.'
units.literal: Moreover ordered commanderies kingdoms do not collect this year horse mouth money, three adjutants, grand minister ceremonies commanderies able use coarse grain substitute taxes."

units.zh: 詔曰：「乃者民被水災，頗匱於食，朕虛倉廩，使使者振困乏。
units.en: An edict stated: 'Recently the people suffered from flood disasters and are considerably lacking in food. I have emptied the granaries and sent envoys to relieve those in poverty and want.
units.literal: Edict said: Recently people suffered flood disaster, considerably lacking food, I emptied granaries, sent envoys relieved impoverished lacking.

units.zh: 其止四年毋漕。
units.en: Moreover, cease the grain transport tribute for four years.
units.literal: Moreover, stop grain transport tribute for four years.

units.zh: 三年以前所振貸，非丞相御史所請，邊郡受牛者勿收責。」
units.en: For relief and loans issued before the third year, if not requested by the chancellor or imperial secretary, do not collect repayment from those border commanderies that had received oxen.'
units.literal: For what was relieved and loaned before the third year, if not requested by the chancellor or imperial secretary, do not collect repayment from those border commanderies that received oxen."

units.zh: 夏四月，詔曰：「度遼將軍明友前以羌騎校尉將羌王侯君長以下擊益州反虜，後復率擊武都反氐，今破烏桓，斬虜獲生，有功。
units.en: In the fourth month of summer, an edict stated: 'General Ming You, who crosses the Liao, previously as Qiang Cavalry Colonel led Qiang kings, marquises, and chiefs and below to attack the rebel bandits of Yizhou, and afterwards again led troops to attack the rebel Di of Wudu. Now he has defeated the Wuhuan, beheaded and captured alive, and has merit.
units.literal: Summer fourth month, edict said: Cross Liao general Ming You previously as Qiang cavalry colonel led Qiang kings marquises chiefs below attacked Yizhou rebel bandits, afterwards again led attacked Wudu rebel Di, now broken Wuhuan, beheaded captured alive, have merit.

units.zh: 其封明友為平陵侯。
units.en: Therefore, enfeoff Ming You as Marquis of Pingling.
units.literal: Therefore enfeoff Ming You as Marquis of Pingling.

units.zh: 平樂監傅介子持節使，誅斬樓蘭王安，歸首縣北闕，封義陽侯。」
units.en: Ping Le Supervisor Fu Jiezi, holding an imperial tally as envoy, executed and beheaded King An of Loulan, returned and displayed the head at the north gate of the capital, and was enfeoffed as Marquis of Yiyang.'
units.literal: Ping Le Supervisor Fu Jiezi, holding imperial tally as envoy, executed and beheaded King An of Loulan, returned and displayed the head at the north gate of the capital, and was enfeoffed as Marquis of Yiyang."

units.zh: 詔曰：「夫穀賤傷農，今三輔、太常穀減賤，其令以叔粟當今年賦。」
units.en: An edict declared: 'When grain prices are too low, it harms the farmers. The grain in the Three Adjuncts and the Grand Ceremonies office has become cheaper. I order that coarse millet be accepted in lieu of this year's taxes.'
units.literal: Edict said: 'Grain being cheap harms farmers, now Three Adjuncts and Grand Ceremonies grain has decreased and is cheap, order to use coarse millet to substitute for this year's taxes.'

units.zh: 元平元年春二月，詔曰：「天下以農桑為本。
units.en: In the second month of spring in the first year of the Yuanping era, an edict declared: 'Agriculture and sericulture form the foundation of the empire.
units.literal: First year of Yuanping spring second month, edict said: 'The empire takes farming and sericulture as foundation.

units.zh: 日者省用，罷不急官，減外繇，耕桑者益眾，而百姓未能家給，朕甚愍焉。
units.en: Recently, expenditures have been reduced, non-essential offices abolished, and external corvée labor decreased. More people are engaged in farming and sericulture, yet the common people still cannot provide for their households. I am deeply troubled by this.
units.literal: Recently reduced expenditures, abolished non-urgent offices, decreased external corvée, farmers and silk producers increasingly numerous, yet common people cannot provide for their families, I greatly pity this.

units.zh: 其減口賦錢。」
units.en: The poll tax should be reduced.'
units.literal: Reduce the poll tax money.'

units.zh: 六月春正月，上耕于上林。
units.en: In the first month of spring of the sixth year, His Majesty performed the plowing ceremony at Shanglin Park.
units.literal: Sixth year spring first month: His Majesty plowed at Shanglin.

units.zh: 二年夏四月，上自建章宮徙未央宮，大置酒。
units.en: In the fourth month of summer in the second year, His Majesty moved from Jianzhang Palace to Weiyang Palace and held a great banquet.
units.literal: Second year summer fourth month: His Majesty moved from Jianzhang Palace to Weiyang Palace, greatly prepared wine.

units.zh: 四年春正月丁亥，帝加元服，見于高廟。
units.en: In the first month of spring in the fourth year, on a Dinghai day, the Emperor underwent the capping ceremony and made an appearance at the Gao Temple.
units.literal: Fourth year spring first month Dinghai: Emperor added crown ceremony, appeared at Gao Temple.

units.zh: 夫能詘於一人之下，而信於萬乘之上者，湯武是也。
units.en: Tang and King Wu could submit to one ruler for a time and ultimately rise above the sovereign of ten thousand chariots.
units.literal: Those able to bend beneath one man and then rise above the ruler of ten thousand chariots were Tang and King Wu.

units.zh: 邦內傷心，有識悲悼，咸以吳國夫差復存，先帝親賢，陛下反之，是陛下不遵先帝二也；
units.en: The whole court grieved; men said King Fuchai of Wu had come again. The late emperor cherished worth; you do the opposite—this is the second way you abandon his model;
units.literal: Within the state hearts were wounded, those with understanding mourned in grief; all thought that Wu's Fuchai had returned to life; the late emperor honored the worthy—Your Majesty does the opposite: this is the second instance of Your Majesty's not following the late emperor;

units.zh: 灌嬰追斬羽東 城。
units.en: Guan Ying pursued and beheaded Xiang Yu at Dongcheng.
units.literal: Guan Ying pursued and beheaded Xiang Yu at Dongcheng.

units.zh: 陳平、灌嬰將十萬守滎陽，樊噲、周勃將二十 萬定燕代，此聞帝崩，諸將皆誅，必連兵還鄉，以攻關中。
units.en: Chen Ping and Guan Ying are leading 100,000 men guarding Xingyang, and Fan Kuai and Zhou Bo are leading 200,000 pacifying Yan and Dai. If they hear that the emperor has died and that the generals are all being executed, they will surely join forces and return home to attack Guanzhong.
units.literal: Chen Ping and Guan Ying lead 100,000 guarding Xingyang, Fan Kuai and Zhou Bo lead 200,000 pacifying Yan and Dai. If they hear the emperor has died and the generals are all executed, they will surely join forces and return home to attack Guanzhong.

units.zh: 而賈誼為梁懷王傅，王墮馬薨，誼不食，毒恨而死。
units.en: Jia Yi became tutor to King Huai of Liang. When the king fell from his horse and died, Jia Yi refused food and perished of grief and bitter remorse.
units.literal: And Jia Yi became tutor to King Huai of Liang; when the king fell from his horse and died, Jia Yi refused to eat and died of grief and bitter regret.

units.zh: 放勛、重華之世，咸無意於受終，當塗、典午之君，雖有心於揖讓，皆以英才處萬乘，高勳御四海，故能大庇黔首，光宅區縣。
units.en: Yao and Shun took the throne without seeking it; the rulers of Wei and Jin, though they spoke of abdication, still set men of rare talent upon the throne and men of towering merit at the helm of the realm—thus they sheltered the people and brought order to the land.
units.literal: In the ages of Fangxun and Chonghua, both were without intent to receive the end; the lords of Dangtu and Dianwu, though they had mind for yielding, all alike placed men of outstanding talent upon the ten-thousand chariots, with high merit steering the four seas—therefore they could greatly shelter the black-haired people and brightly settle the districts and counties.

units.zh: 既而煙雲表色，日月呈瑞，緯聚東井，龍見譙邦，除舊布新，既彰玄象，遷虞事夏，且協謳訟，[2]九域八荒，同布衷款，百神群祀，皆有誠願。
units.en: Then clouds and mist took auspicious hues; sun and moon showed signs; stars clustered at the Eastern Well; a dragon was seen in Qiao. The old order gave way to the new, and Heaven's signs were plain; as in the transfer from Shun to Yu, the people's acclaim agreed. [2] Within the nine provinces and beyond the eight directions, loyal petitions poured in; every spirit and rite was offered in earnest devotion.
units.literal: Thereafter clouds and mist showed color; sun and moon presented omens; constellations gathered at the Eastern Well; a dragon appeared in the Qiao region. Removing the old and spreading the new, the dark signs were already manifest; shifting from Yu and serving Xia, and moreover matching the songs of praise, [2] the nine domains and eight wilds alike spread forth sincere petitions; the hundred spirits and assembled sacrifices all had sincere wish.

units.zh: 梁氏以天祿斯改，期運永終，欽若唐、虞，推其鼎玉，朕東西退讓，拜手陳辭，避舜子於箕山之陽，求支伯於滄洲之野，而公卿敦逼，率土翹惶，天命難稽，遂享嘉祚。
units.en: The House of Liang, its mandate spent, its turn complete—like Tang and Yu they offered up the regalia. We yielded east and west, bowed with joined hands and pleaded our case, hiding like Shun's son on Mount Ji's sunny slope, seeking Zhibo on Cangzhou's wilds—but ministers pressed us and the realm looked up in dread. Heaven's mandate would not wait; thus We received the glorious throne.
units.literal: The House of Liang, its heavenly blessing now changed, its allotted span ended forever—reverently in accord with Tang and Yu, they pushed forth their tripod and jade. We yielded east and west, bowed with joined hands and spoke our plea, avoiding Shun's son on the sunny slope of Mount Ji, seeking Zhibo on the wilds of Cangzhou—but the dukes and ministers pressed urgently; the whole land looked up in alarm. Heaven's mandate could not be delayed; thus We received the fine fortune.

units.zh: 太尉周勃道太原入定代地，至馬邑，馬邑不下，攻殘之。
units.en: Grand marshal Zhou Bo took the Taiyuan route to pacify Dai territory, reaching Mayi. Mayi did not submit, so he attacked and devastated it.
units.literal: Grand marshal Zhou Bo took the Taiyuan route to pacify Dai territory, reaching Mayi. Mayi did not submit, so he attacked and devastated it.

units.zh: 周勃重厚少文，然安劉氏者必勃也，可令為太尉。」
units.en: Zhou Bo is steady and substantial but short on refinement. Yet the man who will secure the Liu clan must be Bo. He can be made Grand Marshal."
units.literal: Zhou Bo is solid and sincere but lacks refinement. However, the one who will secure the Liu clan must be Bo. Can make him grand marshal."

units.zh: 久之，王問仲舒曰：「粵王勾踐與大夫洩庸、種、蠡謀伐吳，遂滅之。
units.en: One day the king asked, "Goujian of Yue and his ministers Xie Yong, Wen Zhong, and Fan Li destroyed Wu by counsel.
units.literal: After a long time the king asked Zhongshu, saying: "The Yue king Goujian, with his great officers Xie Yong, Zhong, and Li, plotted to attack Wu and thereby destroyed it.

units.zh: 時穆子容為巡省使，嘆曰：「古人有言：『聞伯夷之風，貪夫廉，懦夫有立。』
units.en: At the time Mu Zirong was touring inspector; he sighed and said, "The ancients said: 'Hear the wind of Bo Yi, and the greedy grow honest; the timid stand firm.'
units.literal: At the time Mu Zirong was touring inspector; he sighed and said: "The ancients had a saying: 'When one hears the wind of Bo Yi, the greedy grow honest and the timid stand firm.'

units.zh: 李渾 子湛 渾弟繪 族子公緒 李璵 弟瑾 族弟曉 鄭述祖 子元德
units.en: Li Hun; his son Zhan; Hun's brother Hui; clansman Gongxu; Li Yu; brother Jin; clansman Xiao; Zheng Shuzu; son Yuande
units.literal: Li Hun; his son Zhan; Hun's brother Hui; clansman Gongxu; Li Yu; brother Jin; clansman Xiao; Zheng Shuzu; son Yuande

units.zh: 客難東方朔曰：「蘇秦、張儀一當萬乘之主，而都卿相之位，澤及後世。
units.en: The guest reproached Dongfang Shuo: "Su Qin and Zhang Yi each won an audience with a great king and walked away as chief minister; their good fortune lasted for generations.
units.literal: A guest rebuked Dongfang Shuo, saying: "Su Qin and Zhang Yi, each in one encounter with a ruler of ten thousand chariots, then occupied minister and chancellor positions, and their bounty reached later generations.

units.zh: 及楚相春申君亦見王無子，心利楚國，即獻有身妻而產懷王。
units.en: Chu's chancellor Lord Chunshen did the same when he saw the king had no heir, scheming for Chu's advantage by presenting a pregnant wife who bore King Huai of Chu.
units.literal: And Chu chancellor Lord Chunshen likewise saw the king had no son, his heart set on benefiting the state of Chu; he then presented a pregnant wife and she bore King Huai.

units.zh: 夫以四子之行，屈平之材，然猶不能自顯而被刑戮，豈不足以觀哉！
units.en: For men of such conduct and Qu Yuan's talent still could not display themselves and met execution—does it not suffice for reflection!
units.literal: For men of such conduct and Qu Yuan's talent still could not display themselves and met execution—does it not suffice for reflection!

units.zh: 穰侯，昭王之舅也，權重於秦，威震鄰敵，有旦莫偃伏之愛，心不介然有間，然范雎起徒步，由異國，無雅信，開一朝之說，而穰侯就封。
units.en: Marquis Rang, uncle to King Zhao of Qin, dominated that state and awed its neighbors; he shared the king's pillow and board without a shadow between them—yet Fan Ju, a stranger on foot, won a single hearing and sent Rang packing to his domain.
units.literal: Marquis Rang was King Zhao of Qin maternal uncle; his weight of power was in Qin, his awesomeness shook neighboring enemies; he had morning-and-evening couch-bending love, his mind was not stuck with a gap—yet Fan Ju rose from walking the roads, came from a different state, had no long-standing trust, opened one morning persuasion, and Marquis Rang went to his fief.

units.zh: 高宗遭雊雉之戒，飭己正事，享百年之壽，殷道復興，要在所以應之。
units.en: Gaozong of Shang heeded the warning of the crowing pheasant, corrected himself and set affairs right, enjoyed a lifespan of a hundred years, and restored the Shang way. Everything turns on how a ruler responds to such a warning.
units.literal: Gaozong received the pheasant's crowing warning, corrected himself and set affairs right, enjoyed a hundred years' life, Yin's way again rose—the crux lies in how one responds.

units.zh: 時民近戰國，皆背本趨末，賈誼說上曰：筦子曰「倉廩實而知禮節」。
units.en: At the time popular life resembled the Warring States era, with everyone abandoning farming for marginal trades. Jia Yi urged the emperor, saying: Guanzi says, "When granaries are full, the people know ritual propriety."
units.literal: At the time the people were close to Warring States conditions, all turning from the fundamental to the marginal. Jia Yi persuaded the emperor, saying: Guanzi says, "When granaries are full, the people know ritual propriety."

units.zh: 於是上感誼言，始開籍田，躬耕以勸百姓。
units.en: Thereupon the emperor was moved by Jia Yi's words, first opened the imperial plow-fields, and personally plowed to encourage the people.
units.literal: Thereupon the emperor was moved by Jia Yi's words, first opened imperial fields and personally plowed to encourage the people.

units.zh: 漢之為漢幾四十年矣，公私之積猶可哀痛。
units.en: Even after decades, both state and household reserves remained fragile.
units.literal: Han has been Han nearly forty years, yet public and private accumulations are still pitiably painful.

units.zh: 民不足而可治者，自古及今，未之嘗聞。
units.en: No regime has stably governed a population in chronic deprivation.
units.literal: That people lacking means can still be governed-from ancient to present, this has never been heard.

units.zh: 古之人曰：「一夫不耕，或受之飢；
units.en: The ancients said, 'If one man does not farm, someone will go hungry;
units.literal: Ancients said: 'If one man does not farm, someone suffers hunger;

units.zh: 一女不織，或受之寒。」
units.en: if one woman does not weave, someone will suffer cold.'
units.literal: if one woman does not weave, someone suffers cold.'

units.zh: 生之有時，而用之亡度，則物力必屈。
units.en: If consumption outruns seasonal production, the economy inevitably buckles.
units.literal: Production has its timing, but use has no measure-then productive force must collapse.

units.zh: 古之治天下，至孅至悉也，故其畜積足恃。
units.en: Classical states built high-resolution management, which is why reserves were dependable.
units.literal: Ancient governance of the realm was meticulous to the finest degree; therefore their stores were sufficient to rely on.

units.zh: 今背本而趨末，食者甚眾，是天下之大殘也；
units.en: When society abandons productive fundamentals for secondary pursuits, macroeconomic damage follows.
units.literal: Now people turn away from root and rush to branch, while consumers are many-this is the realm's great injury;

units.zh: 淫侈之俗，日日以長，是天下之大賊也。
units.en: Escalating luxury culture is treated as parasitic extraction from real production.
units.literal: and luxurious, extravagant custom grows daily-this is the realm's great thief.

units.zh: 殘賊公行，莫之或止；
units.en: Predatory behavior has become normalized and unchecked;
units.literal: Injury and theft run openly, with none to stop them;

units.zh: 大命將泛，莫之振救。
units.en: political legitimacy itself is nearing systemic failure.
units.literal: the great mandate is about to drift, with none to rescue and stabilize it.

units.zh: 生之者甚少而靡之者甚多，天下財產何得不蹶！
units.en: A widening producer-consumer imbalance makes fiscal collapse unavoidable.
units.literal: Those who produce are very few while those who consume are very many-how can the realm's wealth not collapse!

units.zh: 失時不雨，民且狼顧；
units.en: Any weather shock immediately triggers social anxiety and scarcity behavior;
units.literal: If seasonal rain fails, people already look about like wolves;

units.zh: 歲惡不入，請賣爵、子。
units.en: In severe scarcity, people seek desperate liquidity-including status sales and family liquidation.
units.literal: if bad harvest yields no intake, they request selling ranks and even children.

units.zh: 既聞耳矣，安有為天下阽危者若是而上不驚者！
units.en: Given such warning signs, elite complacency is inexcusable.
units.literal: We have already heard this-how can the realm be in such peril and those above not be alarmed!

units.zh: 世之有飢穰，天之行也，禹、湯被之矣。
units.en: Famine and abundance are Heaven's recurrent course; Yu and Tang experienced them too.
units.literal: Ages have famine and abundance-this is Heaven's operation; Yu and Tang experienced it too.

units.zh: 即不幸有方二三千里之旱，國胡以相恤？
units.en: Large-scale drought requires coordinated interregional relief capacity.
units.literal: If by misfortune there is drought over two or three thousand li, how can the state mutually relieve it?

units.zh: 卒然邊境有急，數十百萬之眾，國胡以餽之？
units.en: Likewise, emergency mobilization needs strategic grain depth.
units.literal: If suddenly borders are urgent and crowds of hundreds of thousands arise, how can the state provision them?

units.zh: 兵旱相乘，天下大屈，有勇力者聚徒而衡擊，罷夫羸老易子而沦其骨。
units.en: Compound shocks of war plus famine produce social violence and extreme famine behaviors.
units.literal: When war and drought strike together, the world greatly bends: those with strength gather bands and attack; exhausted elders exchange children and gnaw their bones.

units.zh: 政治未畢通也，遠方之能疑者並舉而爭起矣，乃駭而圖之，豈將有及乎？
units.en: Without integrated governance beforehand, crisis response comes too late.
units.literal: If governance has not yet been fully connected, distant powers still able to doubt will all rise and contend; then to panic and plan, how could there be time?

units.zh: 夫積貯者，天下之大命也。
units.en: Strategic reserves are the state's core survival mechanism.
units.literal: Accumulated storage is the great lifeline of the realm.

units.zh: 苟粟多而財有餘，何為而不成？
units.en: With deep reserves, nearly all strategic aims become feasible.
units.literal: If grain is abundant and wealth in surplus, what objective cannot be accomplished?

units.zh: 以攻則取，以守則固，以戰則勝。
units.en: Reserves convert directly into offensive, defensive, and battlefield advantage.
units.literal: To attack, one takes; to defend, one is firm; to fight, one wins.

units.zh: 懷敵附遠，何招而不至？
units.en: Material strength also enhances diplomacy and long-distance attraction.
units.literal: Holding enemies and attaching distant peoples-what summons would not come?

units.zh: 今毆民而歸之農，皆著於本，使天下各食其力，末技游食之民轉而緣南畝，則畜積足而人樂其所矣。
units.en: Re-agrarianization and labor reallocation toward primary production would stabilize both reserves and social satisfaction.
units.literal: Now if we drive people back to agriculture, all fixed on the root, so everyone eats by labor and roaming eaters of secondary skills turn toward southern furrows, then stores suffice and people enjoy their place.

units.zh: 可以為富安天下，而直為此廩廩也，竊為陛下惜之！
units.en: The policy path to security is available, making current anxiety feel self-inflicted.
units.literal: This could enrich and secure the realm, yet we only remain trembling in fear-I secretly regret this for Your Majesty.

units.zh: 於是太子犯法。
units.en: Then the crown prince violated the law.
units.literal: Then the crown prince violated the law.

units.zh: 太子，君嗣也，不可施刑，刑其傅公子虔，黥其師公孫賈。
units.en: The crown prince is the ruler's heir and cannot be punished. Instead, his tutor Gongzi Qian was tattooed and his teacher Gongsun Jia was branded.
units.literal: The crown prince is the ruler heir, cannot apply punishment, punished his tutor Gongzi Qian by tattoo, branded his teacher Gongsun Jia.

units.zh: 後五月而秦孝公卒，太子立。
units.en: After five months, Duke Xiao of Qin died, and the crown prince was established as ruler.
units.literal: After five months Qin Duke Xiao died, crown prince established.

units.zh: 秦惠王車裂商君以徇，曰：「莫如商鞅反者！」
units.en: King Hui of Qin had Lord Shang's body torn apart by chariots as a warning, saying: 'Let no one be like Shang Yang in rebelling!'
units.literal: Qin Hui Wang ripped apart Lord Shang body to warn, said: "None like Lord Shang rebel!"

units.zh: 論曰：昔楚頃襄王問陽陵君曰：『君子之富何如？』
units.en: The historian remarks: King Qingxiang of Chu once asked the lord of Yangling what a gentleman's wealth should be.
units.literal: The treatise says: Formerly King Qingxiang of Chu asked the lord of Yangling, saying, 'What is the noble man's wealth like?'

units.zh: 累既攀夫傅說兮，奚不信而遂行？
units.en: Once you had climbed to Fu Yue in dream— why not trust the sign and press on?
units.literal: You had already climbed to Fu Yue— why not trust and go straight on?

units.zh: 春霖謂：「古者鄭寵共叔，失教旋譏，漢驕厲王，不容終病，載在史冊，為萬世戒。
units.en: Chunlin said: "In antiquity, when Zheng favored Gongshu, loss of instruction brought swift reproach; when Han favored the arrogant Prince Li, he was not allowed to end his illness—these are recorded in the histories as warnings for ten thousand generations.
units.literal: Chunlin said: "In antiquity, when Zheng favored Gongshu, loss of instruction brought swift reproach; when Han favored the arrogant Prince Li, he was not allowed to end his illness—these are recorded in the histories as warnings for ten thousand generations.

units.zh: 如此，則使離婁督繩，公輸削墨，雖崇臺五增，延袤百丈，而不溷者，工用相得也。
units.en: Set Li Lou to snap the plumb line and Gongshu Ban to true the ink, and terraces may rise five stories and stretch a hundred yards without the least disorder, for master and tool are perfectly matched.
units.literal: If it is thus, then causing Li Lou to supervise the line and Gongshu to shave the ink—even though lofty terraces increase fivefold, extending a hundred zhang, yet without confusion—it is craftsman and use suiting each other.

units.zh: 對捍使者尚得死坐，況遊道吐不臣之言，犯慢上之罪，口稱夷、齊，心懷盜跖，欺公賣法，受納苞苴，產隨官厚，財與位積，雖贓汚未露，而姦詐如是。
units.en: Resisting an envoy earns death; how much more unministered words, slighting superiors, mouth naming Yi and Qi while heart harbors robbers, deceiving the public, taking bribes—wealth piled with rank though bribery was not yet exposed.
units.literal: Resisting an envoy still earns death; how much more Youdao's unministered words, the crime of slighting superiors, mouth naming Yi and Qi while heart harboring robbers, deceiving the public and selling the law, receiving wrapped bribes—property following office thick, wealth with rank piled; though bribery was not yet exposed, treachery was such.

units.zh: 漢淮南王欲危社稷，張蒼、馮敬等請論如法，文帝既赦其罪廢徙，王不幸而死，封其二子於故地。
units.en: When the King of Huainan of Han threatened the state, Zhang Cang and Feng Jing urged judgment by law. Emperor Wen pardoned him and banished him. When the king died, Wen enfeoffed his two sons in their former lands.
units.literal: In Han the King of Huainan wished to endanger the altars of soil and grain; Zhang Cang, Feng Jing, and others requested judgment according to law; Emperor Wen had already pardoned his crime and banished him; the king unfortunately died; he enfeoffed his two sons in their former lands.

units.zh: 自此之後，魯周霸、孔安國，雒陽賈嘉，頗能言尚書事。
units.en: From that time on, Zhou Ba and Kong Anguo of Lu, along with Jia Jia of Luoyang, became noted for their discourse on the Documents.
units.literal: From this time onward, Zhou Ba and Kong Anguo of Lu, and Jia Jia of Luoyang, were quite able to discourse on matters of the Documents.

units.zh: 二十一年，與秦共攻楚，敗楚將屈丐，斬首八萬於丹陽。
units.en: In the twenty-first year, they joined Qin in attacking Chu, defeated the Chu general Qu Gai, and took eighty thousand heads at Danyang.
units.literal: In the twenty-first year, they attacked Chu together with Qin, defeated Chu general Qu Gai, and beheaded eighty thousand at Dan Yang.

units.zh: 韓厥，晉景公之三年，晉司寇屠岸賈將作亂，誅靈公之賊趙盾。
units.en: In the third year of Duke Jing of Jin, the Minister of Justice Tu'an Jia plotted to carry out a purge, intending to punish Zhao Dun for the assassination of Duke Ling.
units.literal: Han Jue, in Jin Jing Gong's third year, the Jin Si Kou Tu An Jia was about to rebel and execute Ling Gong's traitor Zhao Dun.
